description: Search. One call walks engines in order and returns the first organic results. engines=auto tries Google, then Brave, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, and Baidu. Omitted gl is us and omitted hl is en. There is no page parameter: the response is always pag… Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

engines.description: Engine order. Default auto tries google, brave, bing, duckduckgo, yahoo, then baidu. A comma-separated list is followed as given. ddg and duck mean duckduckgo. Unknown names are ignored. Default: "auto".

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country code. Defaults to us when omitted. For example us, fr, gb, de.

hl.description: Language code. Defaults to en when omitted. For example en, fr, de.

name: search
title: Search
